title: Third Attack - Automatic Level 75, All Classes
body:
Syntax: PRAC THIRD ATTACK | PRACTICE THIRD ATTACK

Third Attack automatically unlocks at level 75 for Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Genjutsu and Bukijutsu. NO SCROLL is needed. A returning level-75+ player who missed the unlock receives it upon login. A legacy Third Attack scroll may still exist at VNUM 31741, but READ no longer consumes or teaches it.

Effect: A third melee strike is attempted only when Second Attack succeeds in the same combat round, then the Third Attack proficiency check succeeds. It activates automatically in combat, without casting or Chakra cost. Practice it with a teacher after unlocking; subsequent combat use can improve proficiency. Existing mastery is preserved.
